# vha.lokh

> Where Ideas Take Shape. Digital practice specializing in high-speed, mobile-first websites, interactive celebration & wedding portals, digital marketing collateral, and IT support services.

## Core Capabilities & Services
1. **Small Business Websites**
   - High-speed, responsive, sub-2-second loading pages.
   - Built-in 1-tap WhatsApp consultation and direct phone dispatch.
   - Verified Google Maps location pins and 4.6★+ customer review showcases.
   - 100% client code and asset ownership with zero hidden recurring lock-ins.
   - Typical delivery turnaround: 4 to 7 business days.

2. **Wedding Portals & Digital Cards**
   - Interactive couple celebration web applications replacing paper wedding cards.
   - Live online RSVP tracking and guest management.
   - Interactive ceremony countdown timers, Google Maps venue pins, and digital photo archives.
   - High-resolution digital invitation cards optimized for WhatsApp sharing and commercial print.
   - Typical delivery turnaround: 3 to 5 business days (24 to 48 hours for urgent invites).

3. **Posters & Digital Marketing Collateral**
   - High-impact promotional posters, festival marketing flyers, and social media banners (Instagram/WhatsApp).
   - Designed for local business customer conversion and festive campaigns.
   - Turnaround: 24 to 48 hours.

4. **Digital Support & IT Consultation**
   - Custom domain registration (.com, .in), DNS management, and SSL certificate setup.
   - Modern cloud hosting configuration (Vercel, AWS, Cloudflare).
   - Website troubleshooting, speed optimization, and ongoing maintenance.

## Selected Client Works
- **Mata Refrigeration:** B2B industrial website for HVAC and refrigerant gas distributor in Kopar Khairane, Navi Mumbai (https://matha-profile.vercel.app/).
- **Dimple Beauty Salon:** Responsive salon website featuring bilingual menu and WhatsApp booking for luxury salon in Navi Mumbai (https://dimple-beauty-salon.vercel.app/).
- **VRINDA Makeup Artistry:** Bridal & editorial makeup portfolio with high-resolution visual transformations (https://vrinda-make-up-artist.vercel.app/).
- **Lekhak & Anupallavi:** Interactive wedding invitation portal with live RSVP tracking, photo memories, and ceremony countdown (https://lekhak-and-anupallavi.vercel.app/).

## Working Process
1. **Discussion & Scope:** Direct chat on WhatsApp or email to clarify features, design preferences, and timeline.
2. **Draft Preview:** Interactive mockups and live preview staging links shared for client feedback.
3. **Refinement & Testing:** Mobile responsiveness, speed optimization, and form verifications.
4. **Launch & Handover:** Deployment to custom domain with full credentials and asset ownership transferred to client.
